strongest_objection: One-way fine is a restatement of an admitted item. It says that what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor 'names the exit from the gift register, and this item adds that the door does not reopen', but the admitted item already says 'the move does not reverse when the price is removed', already carries the daycare case with 'lateness stayed high after the fine was dropped', and already marks the one-way move as contested; the only thing One-way fine adds is the axis tag, and the tag is wrong on the map's own terms, since the daycare's fee is in the hand of the party owed, exactly the hand Wallet away's waived bill is in, so the item cannot be the holder-only endpoint the seriation note says closes the walk. Cutting it removes the incompatibility edge, leaves six edges and seventeen items, and lets the itinerary close on Feelings clinic, whose carrier, a reception, is the one thing on the map the weaker party cannot even propose, which pairs with the opening body that nothing can be taken from. The second fault is In writing's hand claim, that 'the jump completes only if the stronger party writes': the confirming email, 'to summarize what you told me', makes the record from below and leaves the holder to deny in writing or let silence read as assent, so the jump is not the room's to complete, and the Feelings clinic edge that leans on that claim needs the same correction. Everything else I tried held: I ran the two forcing questions (Am I being detained?, In writing) against each other and each succeeded where the other failed; I ran the two holder refusals (Policy says, Feelings clinic) against each other and the manual turned out to bind the holder and to be appealable where the received feeling is neither; the loop, the fork, and the passage all survived a search for a counter-case.

items.item: One-way fine: a moral obligation becomes a purchasable option when a fee is attached, as in the well-known daycare study, simplified here, where fining late parents produced more late parents, since the fine told them lateness had a price and the price was affordable; the new register lets the obligation be bought instead of honored, and what is lost is the guilt that was doing the enforcing, which in that study did not return when the fine was removed; what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor names the exit from the gift register, and this item adds that the door does not reopen, a hysteresis observed once and generalized here only as a speculation; the jump is the room-holder's and, unlike Wallet away, runs one way.
items.why: Duplicates what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor in mechanism, case, hysteresis, and modality; its declared addition ('the door does not reopen') is already in the admitted item verbatim in sense. Its seriation seat is also wrong: the fee is the party owed's carrier, the same hand as Wallet away, not a room-holder's carrier distinct from the counterparty tier. With it cut, the edge from Wallet away goes, the walk closes on Feelings clinic, and the seriation note's closing sentence must be rewritten: the fee 'cannot be handed back' was the admitted item's claim, not this map's.

items.item: In writing: an oral exchange becomes a record when the weaker party asks for it on paper, as a tenant answers a landlord's assurance with 'could you put that in an email'; the new register binds both to a text rather than to whichever memory the room will believe, and what is lost is speed, the goodwill of a party who reads the request as an accusation, and the asker's own room to stay vague; not the lawyer's letter, which changes the forum and prices every subsequent move, and the jump completes only if the stronger party writes, so 'let's keep this between us' is the refusal's native form.
items.why: The hand is misassigned. 'The jump completes only if the stronger party writes' is false in practice: the weaker party's confirming email ('to summarize what you told me today') creates the record alone and forces the holder to deny in writing, which is itself a record, or to let silence stand as assent. The mechanism, the loss, and the tell all survive; only the completion clause changes, and the item now sits at the boundary between the weaker-owned and the room-completed tiers, which the repairer may leave where it is with the note that the record's later weight, not its existence, is what the room controls.
items.repair: In writing: an oral exchange becomes a record when the weaker party asks for it on paper, as a tenant answers a landlord's assurance with 'could you put that in an email'; the new register binds both to a text rather than to whichever memory the room will believe, and what is lost is speed, the goodwill of a party who reads the request as an accusation, and the asker's own room to stay vague; not the lawyer's letter, which changes the forum and prices every subsequent move, and the jump completes when either party writes, so the weaker party can make it alone with the confirming email, 'to summarize what you told me today', which dares the holder to deny the record in writing or let silence stand as assent; 'let's keep this between us' is the refusal's native form only while nothing is yet written, and the holder's second refusal, the written denial, is itself a record.

items.item: Told, not claimed: a claim becomes unrefutable when it is delivered as a story, as a witness before a commission says 'when I was nine the tap water turned brown' rather than 'the plant polluted the river'; the new register has no proposition to attack, travels by retelling, and recruits by sympathy, and what is lost is remedy, since a story can no more be confirmed than refuted and so cannot be paid out; not the memoir addressed away from the room, but a jump made in the room by anyone with a first person, and the calendar makes it by force when the limitation period turns a claim into something that can only be told.
items.why: Modality: 'so cannot be paid out' is stated as fact and is false as a universal, since truth commissions pay reparations on exactly this testimony. The strange mechanism survives sharper: a story is paid, where it is paid at all, as reparation for a class rather than damages for a wrong, which is what 'remedy is lost' actually means and which strengthens the discriminator from Written for the future court.
items.repair: Told, not claimed: a claim becomes unrefutable when it is delivered as a story, as a witness before a commission says 'when I was nine the tap water turned brown' rather than 'the plant polluted the river'; the new register has no proposition to attack, travels by retelling, and recruits by sympathy, and what is lost is remedy computed to the claim, since a story can no more be confirmed than refuted, so where it is paid at all it is paid as reparation for a class rather than damages for a wrong; not the memoir addressed away from the room, but a jump made in the room by anyone with a first person, and the calendar makes it by force when the limitation period turns a claim into something that can only be told.

items.item: Collapse in the dock: any proceeding becomes an emergency when a body in it fails, as a defendant faints, a negotiator's chest pain empties the table, or a child's fever ends a custody hearing, since no room may continue its business past an unattended body; the new register overrides every other, and what is lost is the matter, suspended rather than settled, and the body's future credibility, spent whether the collapse was chosen or not; the one register entrance no permission can deny to the weakest party, and unlike the fire alarm, which anyone may pull and which a fine guards, this one is guarded by the discount every later collapse suffers.
items.why: Modality only: 'no room may continue its business past an unattended body' is asserted as universal while the map's own wild priority goes hunting for rooms that have written the override out. Soften to 'almost no room' and point at the priority; the mechanism, the discount on later collapses, and the fire-alarm contrast are untouched.
items.repair: Collapse in the dock: any proceeding becomes an emergency when a body in it fails, as a defendant faints, a negotiator's chest pain empties the table, or a child's fever ends a custody hearing, since almost no room may continue its business past an unattended body, and the few that try are the wild priority's quarry; the new register overrides every other, and what is lost is the matter, suspended rather than settled, and the body's future credibility, spent whether the collapse was chosen or not; the one register entrance no permission can deny to the weakest party, and unlike the fire alarm, which anyone may pull and which a fine guards, this one is guarded by the discount every later collapse suffers.

items.item: Am I being detained?: an ambiguous encounter becomes a declared one when the weaker party asks which register they are in, as a driver asks whether they are free to go, an employee asks whether that was an order, or a patient asks whether the scan is recommended or required; the new register is whichever the holder names, but naming it costs the holder the ambiguity that let them act in one register while being accountable in another, and what is lost is goodwill, since the question is itself a hostile act, along with any favor the ambiguity was quietly extending; not a refusal, since the asker complies with whatever is named, but a forcing move whose reach is exactly the reach of the rule that says the holder must answer.
items.why: Tested as my left neighbor against In writing (see neighbor_test); survives. Its reach clause, 'exactly the reach of the rule that says the holder must answer', is the honest modality for the traffic-stop case, where the officer is bound only loosely, and the fork edge to Policy says is the best structural claim on the map.

items.item: Policy says: a personal refusal becomes a categorical one when the manual is produced, as the clerk who cannot say no to a face says 'the policy doesn't allow it'; the new register refuses without insult and applies to everyone equally, and what is lost is the exception, the discretion that could have helped, and the human read of the case; a jump only the holder of the manual can make, and the weaker party's return move, 'let me speak to someone who can decide,' works only where a chair of discretion still exists above the manual, which the manual is often written to abolish.
items.why: Second neighbor pair tested, against Feelings clinic: both are holder refusals to declare, but the manual binds the holder too, so the weaker party can later quote it, and it can be appealed to a chair of discretion where one survives; the received feeling binds nobody and leaves no proposition to appeal. Separable; both keep.

items.item: Feelings clinic: a claim becomes a feeling when it is received as one, as a manager answers 'the schedule is unsafe' with 'I hear that you're feeling stressed'; the new register cannot be wrong and cannot bind, so the room is safe and nothing follows from it, and what is lost is the claim's purchase on the world and the standing of the claimant, who has become a patient; not the diagnosis, which moves an act into pathology, can confine without trial, and can be invoked by the accused as well, but a jump the room-holder makes on the claimant's sentence, and the claimant's counter, restating the feeling as a number or a document, is Let the number say it or In writing entered from below.
items.why: Tested against Policy says (above) and survives; with One-way fine cut it becomes the closing endpoint, and it earns that seat, since a reception is the one carrier on the map the weaker party cannot even propose, the mirror of the body at the opening that no permission can deny. The repairer should say so in the seriation note.

neighbor_test.left: Am I being detained?: an ambiguous encounter becomes a declared one when the weaker party asks which register they are in, as a driver asks whether they are free to go, an employee asks whether that was an order, or a patient asks whether the scan is recommended or required; the new register is whichever the holder names, but naming it costs the holder the ambiguity that let them act in one register while being accountable in another, and what is lost is goodwill, since the question is itself a hostile act, along with any favor the ambiguity was quietly extending; not a refusal, since the asker complies with whatever is named, but a forcing move whose reach is exactly the reach of the rule that says the holder must answer.
neighbor_test.right: In writing: an oral exchange becomes a record when the weaker party asks for it on paper, as a tenant answers a landlord's assurance with 'could you put that in an email'; the new register binds both to a text rather than to whichever memory the room will believe, and what is lost is speed, the goodwill of a party who reads the request as an accusation, and the asker's own room to stay vague; not the lawyer's letter, which changes the forum and prices every subsequent move, and the jump completes only if the stronger party writes, so 'let's keep this between us' is the refusal's native form.
neighbor_test.separating_case: An employee is told to redate an invoice. She asks 'is that an order?' and the manager says 'yes': the register is now declared, responsibility for the act has moved up, and nothing is recorded. She then asks 'could you put that in an email?' and the manager says 'let's keep this between us': the second jump is refused while the first succeeded. Run it the other way: the manager emails 'please handle the invoice dates as we discussed', and a record exists in which the register is still undeclared, a request or an order, nobody can say. Each jump succeeds where the other fails, because the question strips ambiguity about which register they are in now and the text strips deniability about what was said, and neither does the other's work. They do not collapse.

boundary_case: Call the question, 'let's just vote on it'. Tempting because it looks like Let the number say it with a count in place of an instrument: a contested decision becomes a tally, and the loser is nobody because the numbers decided. The ruling depends on the room. In a body that already votes, a council, a board, a union local, it is a closing move inside the existing register, Robert's previous question, and out; in a family or a founding team that has never voted, it changes what counts as a move and what closes the matter, and is in. The type survives the test because it stipulates a register as the room's existing rules for speakers, moves, and closes, so the same words are a move in one room and a jump in another, which is what a definition by rules rather than by vocabulary should produce. Where it is in, it is a member the map lacks: the count needs no instrument owner, so it is a jump anyone in the room can propose and the room completes by agreeing to be counted, and what is lost is the argument, which a tally ends without answering.

seriation.note: The axis has a real opening endpoint (a body, which nothing can be taken from except by force) and, after the cut, a real closing endpoint (a reception, which nothing can be handed to). As written, the closing endpoint fails: One-way fine's fee is the party owed's carrier, the same hand as Wallet away's waived bill, so the two 'price jumps' sit at opposite ends of an axis that should have them adjacent. The hinge Bring a friend → Duel's seconds teaches (one body makes testimony, two who confer make a rule) and the Call the police / Written for the future court adjacency teaches (the state now, the archive later; one takes the case, the other leaves it). The repaired In writing sits at the boundary of the first two tiers; the repairer may leave it in place with a note that the room controls the record's later weight, not its existence. The seriation note's closing sentence must be rewritten for Feelings clinic, and the sentence about the four room-holder jumps sharing a shape becomes three.

edges.why: Falls with the item; the label's claim, that a mechanic who waves one bill and sends the next has ended the gift rather than restored trade, is Invoice that ends the favor's own claim. The 'incompatibility' in form_inference goes with it; four relation kinds remain.

'The claimant's only return' is too strong, and 'if the manager then declines to write, the decline is the second jump's tell' depends on the hand claim being repaired in In writing: the claimant can write the record alone, so the manager's refusal moves from declining to write to denying in writing or staying silent.
edges.repair_label: If a claim is received as a feeling, the claimant's return is a carrier that cannot be received as one, a text or a number, and the claimant can make the text alone, 'to confirm, I reported the schedule as unsafe and you said you heard that I was stressed', so that the manager must deny the record in writing or let silence stand as assent; Feelings clinic recruits In writing from below, and the holder's refusal moves from the sentence, where it was safe, to the record, where it is not.

edges.why: 'The complainant's remaining jump is the archive' is false on the item's own terms: the civil rung, the letterhead named in Call the police's discriminator, stays open when the state declines. The degradation claim survives once 'remaining' is removed.
edges.repair_label: If the state declines the report, the report does not come back to the complainant as a case but stays as a document, written now for a reader not yet present, so the heaviest present-tense jump degrades into the future-tense one while the civil rung stays open beside it; what was filed to compel is kept to be found.

edges.why: Tried to break the loop with a bug that a reorganization actually fixes (an ownerless service); the loop then simply does not turn, which is the antecedent failing, not the claim. Keep.

Tried a holder who answers the forcing question with silence rather than a declaration or a manual; that is the third tine the item already prices ('exactly the reach of the rule that says the holder must answer'), so the fork stands with silence as the case where the rule is absent.

modality_problems: Collapse in the dock asserts 'no room may continue its business past an unattended body' as a universal while the map's own wild priority hunts for rooms that have written the override out; repaired to 'almost no room'.

Told, not claimed asserts a story 'cannot be paid out' as fact; truth commissions pay reparations on precisely this testimony. Repaired to reparation-for-a-class versus damages-for-a-wrong, which is the sharper form of the same loss.
One-way fine's modality was handled honestly, but the item is a duplicate; the hysteresis it marks speculative was already marked contested in the admitted item it cites.
The edge Call the police → Written for the future court promoted 'the remaining jump' from a tendency to an exclusion that the source item itself contradicts; repaired.
duplication: One-way fine duplicates what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor (same mechanism, same daycare case, same non-reversal, same contested modality); cut. Two lighter overlaps are not duplicates and need no change: discourse-terminators' 'irony shield: every claim retractable as a joke' is The room's laugh's 'only joking' clause, and its 'lived-experience seal' borders Told, not claimed, but both terminators are one-line moves and the map's items add what the new register can do, what is lost, and whose hand the carrier is in. The map as a whole duplicates no grown list; status-conversions is about standing and passages-between-levels about levels, and neither has register in the map's stipulated sense.
best_unresolved_seed: State of emergency, the holder's declaration that suspends a room's ordinary register, which the ledger rejected at the count's cap. It is the true holder-only endpoint the map lacks, the top door to the register that Collapse in the dock enters from the bottom, and it breaks the map's own finding that room-holder jumps are refusals to declare: the emergency is the one holder jump that declares loudly, so seating it would test whether the changed question ('which jumps force the holder to declare') was about hands or about declarations. Close behind it: Off the record, a weaker-party proposal the room completes by agreeing, in a domain (the press) the map never enters, and Call the question, the instrument-free count that the boundary case turned up.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after cutting One-way fine as a restatement of the admitted Invoice that ends the favor, repairing In writing's hand claim and two modality overstatements, relabeling two edges, and closing the seriation on Feelings clinic.
